Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex aerothermal findings into clear design recommendations for multidisciplinary teams. Nice to have General Aerodynamic Knowledge: Familiarity with the fundamentals of external aerodynamics — lift and drag generation, pressure distributions, boundary layer behaviour, and flow separation — as applied to fixed-wing or multirotor UAV platforms. Set up standardized evaluation and regression testing so that every model release is measurably better. Build internal tools to visualize and debug sensor data, predictions and model performance. Profile 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering focused on computer vision or 3D perception, ideally in robotics or autonomous systems. Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent). Hands-on experience with 2D and 3D perception: detection, segmentation, pose estimation, point clouds or multi-sensor fusion. Experience deploying perception models to production under hardware constraints. Solid understanding of data pipelines: collection, cleaning, labeling and quality measurement. Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, camera and lidar calibration, synthetic data generation, C++ or perception for logistics environments. Responsabilités Développer, entraîner et évaluer des modèles de perception embarqués : object detection, segmentation, pose estimation et scene understanding. Fusionner les données de plusieurs capteurs (caméras, capteurs de profondeur, lidar, IMU) pour une perception robuste en conditions réelles d'exploitation. Définir et mesurer la data quality pour la perception, et automatiser l'extraction de datasets et le labeling à partir des logs terrain. Garantir la fiabilité des modèles à chaque étape du déploiement, des PoC et field tests jusqu'à la production, y compris face aux variations d'éclairage, de charges et de sites. Mettre en place une évaluation standardisée et des tests de non-régression pour que chaque release de modèle soit mesurablement meilleure. title: Inertial Navigation Engineer Intern
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing advanced autonomous systems that rely on robust state estimation and sensor fusion to operate in complex, dynamic environments. Our platforms integrate multiple sensors (e.g., IMU, GNSS, vision, barometer, magnetometer) and require accurate, real-time estimation of system states (position, velocity, attitude, etc). Classical approaches such as Kalman filtering are powerful but rely on modeling assumptions that often break down in real-world conditions. To push performance beyond these limits, we are exploring hybrid approaches that combine model-based estimation with modern machine learning techniques. Your mission The goal of this internship is to explore and apply machine learning-based sensor fusion and state estimation methods to improve performance in dynamic environments. Responsibilities Literature review : Conduct a comprehensive review of existing ML methods for state estimation and sensor fusion. Algorithm Implementation : Develop and implement various algorithms based on the literature review and project requirements using simulated and real-world flight data. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and computational overhead of the developed algorithms with classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results, and conclusions. Flight Tests Participation : Actively participate in flight test sessions to gather real-world data and validate the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in operational conditions. Contribute to real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record in applied mathematics, machine learning, robotics or a related fied. Knowledge of sensor fusion/state estimation is a strong plus. Technical Skills: Strong understanding of ML fundamentals. Experience with State Estimation, drones, or Control Theory is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: INTESCIA - DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) - Stage MASTER II (6 mois)
location: CARQUEFOU, Pays de la Loire, France
description: DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. Contexte du stage Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ». Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place. Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie. Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe. Votre mission : L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées. Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse. Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus. Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont : • Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore • Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise • Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail.   Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel. Informations importantes ð  Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ; ð  Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia.   Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs.   Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty. Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec.     • Les étapes du recrutement seront les suivantes :    1er entretien avec Julie QUEIROS , DATA SCIENTIST chez Explore, accompagnée du personnel encadrant du laboratoire ;    2ème entretien et restitution de cas pratique avec Julie, accompagnée de son N+1 Steven HELLEC, ainsi que des encadrants du laboratoire ;    3ème et dernier entretien avec l’équipe RH, pour tout formaliser. Le profil que nous recherchons       Étudiant·e de Master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Informatique / Mathématiques Information / Statistiques / Traitement du langage naturel / Data Science.        Appétence à la recherche         Connaissances en : Python, SQL, Méthodes de NLP         Maîtrise de l’anglais         Qualités de rédaction, d’analyse et d’autonomie appréciées. description: About Us Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care. Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on. Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members. We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you. If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use. The Job We're looking for a talented and driven Product Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build across the whole stack, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Your goal is to shrink the time from a customer request to a deployed solution, without cutting corners on reliability or on the privacy of residents' health data. In this role, you will focus on: Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them. Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward. Fast Iteration: Break large designs and features into small shippable pieces. Get MVPs in front of users quickly, measure how they're used, and iterate or kill them. Backend & APIs: Design and build the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them. Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Build test coverage and use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on. Qualifications Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build. Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native. Comfortable working across the stack: you've built backend APIs and worked with relational databases (e.g. Postgres), not just UI. Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed. Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions. Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team. Nice to Have Experience with React Native and Expo in production. AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience. Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications. Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR). Experience shipping products across multiple markets and languages. What We Offer Participation in our warrant program (stock options). A small team where your decisions directly shape the product. Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate. Join Our Team We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job. At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work. If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare. title: Avionics System Engineer - Navigation Sensors
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. As a Senior Navigation Sensors engineer, you will support the integration and testing of the Nyx navigation sensors – Inertial measurement Unit (IMU), GNSS Receiver, Star Tracker and LiDAR – ensuring seamless integration and performance of the Navigation Sensing Suite (NSS) functional chain. Key Responsibilities Navigation Sensor Systems Development Take technical ownership of the spacecraft's navigation sensor suite, including requirements definition, architecture, component selection, and system-level performance. Define and maintain sensor requirements, specifications, and interfaces in alignment with overall spacecraft mission and system requirements. Assess sensor technologies, evaluate design trade-offs, and drive technical decisions to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and suitability for the mission. Ensure proper integration of navigation sensors into the spacecraft avionics architecture. Supplier and Component Management Act as the technical focal point for navigation sensor suppliers throughout the component development lifecycle. Coordinate technical reviews, manage supplier deliverables, and resolve technical issues throughout development and procurement. Testing, Verification and Certification Develop and maintain verification and qualification strategies for navigation sensor components and systems. Define and review test plans, procedures, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate and support component-level testing, environmental qualification, functional verification, and system integration testing. Analyze test results, assess compliance with requirements, and drive resolution of identified anomalies. Prepare and maintain verification evidence and technical documentation to support qualification, certification, and mission readiness. Support reviews and technical interactions with customers, external stakeholders, and certification authorities. GNC and Cross-Functional Integration Work closely with the GNC team to define navigation sensor performance requirements and ensure alignment with spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control needs. Collaborate on sensor selection, performance modeling, and system-level performance assessments. Dit doen zij op freelance-basis voor leuke dagklussen in o.a. de horeca, hospitality en de logistiek. De collega’s uit het team waar je terecht komt, zijn verantwoordelijk voor het relatiebeheer van onze opdrachtgevers. En je raadt het al: jouw rol zal hier aan bijdragen. MAAR WAT ZIJN DIE WERKZAAMHEDEN DAN ZOAL? Je beantwoordt de mails en vragen in de livechat vanuit opdrachtgevers; Je schakelt tussen freelancers en bedrijven waar dit nodig is. Jij bent het bruggetje tussen deze twee partijen; Je geeft opvolging aan het klantcontact en helpt de opdrachtgever o.a. bij het plaatsen van de klussen en het maken van de eerste matches op ons platform; Je bent een adviespartner richting klanten en zorgt ervoor dat ze op de hoogte zijn van alle features van het platform; Je ondersteunt de Customer Success Managers met diverse taken. title: Implementation Specialist
description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. You start with a signed contract and support the customer until go-live. This includes translating policies, regulatory obligations and risk factors into Hawk's setup, data mapping, workflow configuration, UAT support and ensuring that key project timelines and milestones are met. You support our customers in realising true value by detecting more financial crime, allowing investigators to focus on what matters instead of drowning in false positives, and adopting state-of-the-art AI technologies. Key Responsibilities Requirements and needs assessment: gather and analyse the customer's AML, fraud and screening requirements and advise on best-practice configuration. Configuration: translate policies, screening algorithms, regulatory requirements and risk factors into Hawk's setup, covering rules, screening, customer risk rating and workflows. Data mapping and integration: lead the technical deployment and integration with the customer's systems, via API or batch mechanisms. Testing and go-live: support the customer through testing, UAT and sign-off, troubleshoot issues, and support a successful transition to a production environment. Training and enablement: deliver training to the customer's teams from a functional as well as technical standpoint. Project management: plan and run the implementation from signature to go-live on time and within scope, with documentation and regular stakeholder updates, combining hands-on work with project leadership. Primary contact: be the first point of contact for implementation questions and issues. Collaboration and feedback: work closely with Customer Value Partners for a smooth implementation, and bring actionable customer feedback and gaps to Product, Development and Hawk's GTM organisation. Document every configuration decision and the reasoning behind it, so the setup holds up when the customer's auditor or regulator asks why a rule was set the way it was. Manage each implementation task and the implementation success as an outcome you own, as directed by our Customer Value Partner, resulting in activity completion and a go-live on the dates you committed to. Your Profile 6+ years in implementation consulting or solution consulting, with at least 3 of those years hands-on implementing AML, fraud or screening solutions. Subject matter expertise in AML and compliance. You are familiar with key typologies and patterns, the regulatory expectations behind them, and how monitoring programmes as well as AI get examined. You can confidently stand in front of an MLRO and discuss and defend a rule set. This is a must-have, not a nice-to-have. Hands-on data skills: SQL, APIs, CSV and JSON, and data modelling. You're familiar with standardised payment message formats, including SWIFT MT and ISO 20022, SEPA and card data. Integration literacy. You don't write production code, but you're at home with APIs, JSON payloads, SFTP configurations as well as SSO. Proven track record of taking complex implementations to go-live on time, ideally several in parallel, with banking customers or other financial institutions. Stakeholder alignment. You ensure that internal and external parties both have the information they need, keep them aligned and manage expectations. Able to explain complexity simply. Imagine data models for compliance leads, fraud typologies for data engineers. You do it clearly in writing and in the room, in fluent English. A degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Bonus Business-fluent German, for working with our DACH customers. CAMS (or equivalent) certification, or time spent in a second-line compliance or MLRO team. Builds constructive relationships with customers and stays calm and under pressure Builder mentality: works independently and brings structure to ambiguity where no established process exists, taking the initiative to define one. Is a resourceful problem-solver who investigates unknowns and tests system behaviour. Knows when and whom to escalate. Manages expectations proactively. Flags timeline and scope risks early, quantifies them, offers phased options and aligns Sales and Customer Success. Handles product gaps transparently. Clarifies the underlying (regulatory) requirement, offers workarounds with their trade-offs, feeds back to Product and doesn't commit to unconfirmed dates . You use AI tools such as Claude in your daily workflow to speed up mapping, documentation and analysis, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't.
